# Vendored cpp-httplib

Source: official repository `https://github.com/yhirose/cpp-httplib.git`.

Imported tag: `v0.58.0`.
Imported commit: `4f3f9ef19be83ae97a5d9a059432dc00e445b7ab`.
License: MIT; see `LICENSE`.

TVStreamer5 uses only the synchronous HTTP/HTTPS client interface with the
OpenSSL backend. The header is wrapped by `src/NativeHttpClient.*` so application
code does not depend directly on cpp-httplib APIs.
